words.meaning: The subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college.
sentences: The school revised its science curriculum to include modern technologies.
Extracurricular activities complement the academic curriculum.
Teachers must follow the national curriculum set by the board of education.

words.meaning: The method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept.
sentences: Modern pedagogy focuses more on interactive learning rather than memorization.
The university offers advanced courses in digital pedagogy for new educators.
Effective pedagogy adapts to the individual learning needs of each student.

words.meaning: A large room or building where an audience gathers to hear lectures, performances, or assemblies.
sentences: The principal addressed all the students in the school auditorium.
The annual drama competition took place in the main auditorium.
Students gathered in the auditorium for the morning assembly.

words.meaning: A piece of work or task given to someone, especially a student, as part of their studies.
sentences: The teacher asked us to submit the math assignment by Friday.
She spent the entire weekend working on her history assignment.
Group assignments help students learn how to collaborate effectively.
